dc_current_example.formula: I=P/V for ideal DC; heating=P_loss=I^2 R
dc_current_example.caption: Illustrative equal-power DC comparison, constant conductor resistance. Doubling voltage halves current and quarters resistive loss in that conductor. Not a site efficiency measurement or comparison with three-phase AC.

annual_energy_example.caption: Arithmetic at continuous full IT load for 365 days, not actual consumption; excludes cooling and electrical losses.

wind_average_example.caption: Original arithmetic using S1's wind nameplate and local capacity-factor range. Gross annual energy ratio before curtailment and storage losses; not hourly coverage, measured Galaxy production or evidence for 24/7 renewables.
